visual.description: Dominant brand red used for buttons, headings in the modal, and section backgrounds throughout the site.
White background of the modal/popup overlay container.
Near-black used for body copy, checkbox label text, and navigation links.
Light gray used as the main page background visible behind the modal and in product grid sections.
Pure black used for large display headings like 'SEASONING', 'MACARONI & CHEESE', 'SALAD DRESSING'.
Light gray border on the email input field in the modal.
Medium gray used for fine print / legal checkbox text in the modal.
Bright cobalt blue used as a section background accent (visible in the 'SEASONING' section behind the product grid).
Deep green used as a section background accent (visible behind the 'MACARONI & CHEESE' category heading).
Golden yellow used as a section background accent for the 'SALAD DRESSING' category section.
